t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There is some combination of gnome colour, hat size and multiplier that indicates which gnome to select, but the player had not managed to figure out the specifics during the time allowed.

vb_textbox.text: I scored more highly when I went right for 5+ modifier and left for 1+ modifier. I scored my lowest when I tried to select for the tallest hat.My score came somewhere in the middle when I went left for 5+ modifier and right for 1+ modifier and also when I selected for colour based on 'yellowness', ie yellow over red, orange over purple, brown over blue.I think the best scores will be from some combination of modifier, colour and hat height, but you don't get a lot of time to think about it, and it's quite fast paced.Don't forget to click the s, k, or space, because I zoned out a few times and wasn't quick enough, and you don't get any mushrooms at all that way!Good luck!
